measurementSemantics.sampling: Fixed wall-time schedule, observing an actual rendered frame at or after each due tick. Missed ticks are counted, never synthesized. cueSeconds uses the existing cutscene playback clock, which can advance differently from wall time. cutsceneSamples are retained separately from the raw v3 history ring and are not restricted by the raw JSON frame window.
measurementSemantics.vertices: vsInvocations is the whole-frame GPU vertex shader invocation count, including passes and internal UI/DirectXTK draws within the query. It is not a unique vertex-buffer count, resident vertices, or final visible geometry.
measurementSemantics.indices: directIndices and indirectIndices cover instrumented Engine indexed submissions, including repeated passes and instance multiplication; totalIndices is their sum only when indexValid. They exclude uninstrumented DirectXTK and separately rendered ImGui draws. These are a different coverage from whole-frame vsInvocations.
measurementSemantics.distance: Meters from the observed camera to each placement/model bounding sphere: centerDistance to its center, nearDistance to its nearest sphere surface. These are not submesh surface distances. Source rows use centerDistance for the requested interval filter; mapDraws retain all instrumented static-map color submissions before that filter.
measurementSemantics.distanceDelta: Stable key (placementId, assetId, meshIndex). Differences use the previous observed sample of that key, which may precede skipped or filtered ticks. First observation has null previous tick, delta and rate. Negative rate means approaching the model sphere center.
measurementSemantics.lod: sources.lodDiagnostic and diagnosticIndexCount are CPU envelope diagnostics only. GPU source-level surviving LOD is not observed. mapDraws.lod describes the submitted draw/bin; a native HLOD path without one LOD number exports null. vertexBufferCount is the bound source VB vertex count, which need not shrink with an index-only LOD. instanceCount is actual only when known or joined with same-frame indirect args.
measurementSemantics.indirectJoin: geometryFrameNumber + indirectBufferOrdinal/bufferOrdinal + argsByteOffset. Ordinals are ephemeral frame-local IDs, never pointers. One map draw uses one instanceCount; argument.drawCount explains repeated use of the same args and must not be multiplied into every map row. Unknown values are null.
measurementSemantics.sourceJoin: sourceIdsKnown is true only when all submitted source placement IDs are observed. GPU draws leave source IDs unknown; source.gpuCohortId and meshIndex join only the cohort/bin aggregate, not individual surviving placements. draw.assetId is a representative asset and is not an exhaustive asset list for a merged draw.
measurementSemantics.frameInterval: frameIntervalMs measures consecutive diagnostic render boundaries before world rendering, while geometry belongs to this rendered frame. It is distinct from raw v3 profiler Begin-to-Begin timing. GPU results may resolve later; currentFrameNumberAtResolve and latencyFrames identify that delay.
